The proposed ANCOVA difference of -10.27 percentage points (95% CI -11.97 to -8.57) is explicitly reported and matches the abstract after rounding. Option B correctly repairs the observed-case denominators but does not establish the declared all-randomized treatment-policy estimand. The packet supports the replacement number; its treatment-policy designation is inferred rather than explicitly stated in the supplied source text.

entry.why: The abstract explicitly establishes adults without diabetes with overweight plus a comorbidity or obesity, randomized double-blind treatment, and once-weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg versus placebo through 68 weeks. Both arms received intensive behavioral therapy and an initial low-calorie diet.

quotes.span: Randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, 68-week, phase 3a study (STEP 3) conducted at 41 sites in the US from August 2018 to April 2020 in adults without diabetes (N = 611) and with either overweight (body mass index ≥27) plus at least 1 comorbidity or obesity (body mass index ≥30).

To compare the effects of once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide, 2.4 mg vs placebo for weight management as an adjunct to intensive behavioral therapy with initial low-calorie diet in adults with overweight or obesity.

Participants were randomized (2:1) to semaglutide, 2.4 mg (n = 407) or placebo (n = 204), both combined with a low-calorie diet for the first 8 weeks and intensive behavioral therapy (ie, 30 counseling visits) during 68 weeks.

missed: The denominator overstatement is 49 participants, not 44: (407 + 204) - (373 + 189) = 49, using the registry denominator quotes above. This arithmetic correction does not change rejection or entry eligibility. The supplied ANCOVA line does not explicitly identify treatment-policy handling or describe missing-data methods; the replacement's exact estimand designation therefore remains less directly documented than its numerical value.
